Callout.Name: Fight in the Yard
Callout.Message: Fight between inmates in the exercise yard.
Callout.Advisory: Several involved, staff responding, no weapons seen.

Script.Line: Two of them in the yard and about twenty watching.
It is over a debt. It is always over a debt.
We need them apart before the watchers decide to join in.

Lines.Approach: Half a dozen of them at it in the yard and the staff are going in. Nobody has used a weapon yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
